title: 'No steering wheel, no pedals': Tesla teases fans ahead of long-awaited Cybercab update
summary: Tesla has generated significant excitement among its fans with the upcoming update for the Cybercab, a project that was first introduced nearly two years ago. The company has teased innovative features, including the absence of a steering wheel and pedals, which aligns with its vision for autonomous driving. As anticipation builds, many are eager to learn more about what this update will entail and how it will reshape urban transportation.
